title: Crispy Thai Tofu Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry recipe made with crispy tofu, crunchy vegetables, and a sweet and sour sauce.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.amount: 1 block, drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the tofu from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the chopped Xtra Crispy Chinese Shu and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sliced bell peppers and onions and cook until they start to soften, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the cooked tofu back into the skillet, along with the Mu Shu, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
Stir-fry everything together for about 2-3 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the tofu is fully coated.
Serve the crispy Thai tofu stir fry hot, garnished with chopped green onions and a sprinkle of Xtra Crispy Chinese Shu.
